scope: Five formal r4 comparison cases; all r3 candidate runs are retained as development failures/samples and excluded from r4 metrics.

arms.baseline: accepted v2 runtime behavior: OpenCode 1.18.31, Qwen default, BROWSER_USAGE only, shared gateway 15 second wait and no backend cooldown
arms.candidate: r4: r3 plus a no-argument fixed managed-preview starter that uses the existing guard and native PTY for /workspace/project/web:5173; no new browser controller

commonConditions.projectInput: immutable authorized T0 snapshot for each run

primaryMetric: Count of cases independently satisfying the stated user behavior without a human solution hint or source edit.
benefitRule: Candidate must independently satisfy more cases than baseline, introduce no severe regression, satisfy both holdouts, and keep each completed run within 24 gateway dispatches and 20 minutes.
costGuardrails: All dispatches, waits, failures and maintenance intervention are retained. Unknown dispatches are never automatically replayed. A model summary never overrides independent behavior, test, build, or export evidence.
repeatRule: C01 is run twice per arm with arm order reversed for the second pair.
holdoutRule: C04 and C05 remain unseen holdouts at this freeze and are not used to change r4 before their runs.
